description: Selecting both complete fresh parents of \(\{P(x_0),P(x_1)\}\) and \(\{\neg P(x_0),\neg P(x_1)\}\), the substitution sending variables \(0,1,2,3\) to \(x_0\) and fixing the others is a most general unifier and the exact generalized resolvent is empty.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.pair_generalized_step.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} (P : L.Relations 1) :
  ∃ d,
    d.positiveFamily =
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.leftCopy
          (Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.pairPositive P) ∧
      d.negativeFamily =
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.rightCopy
            (Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.pairNegative P) ∧
        d.unifier = Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.pairMu ∧
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.resolvent d = ∅
